fields.gap: The cheapest P2 direction on all three leaders is face density alone (factors 1.459, 1.637, 1.655), requiring faces at 959.5, 1129.7 and 906.5 kg/m3 carrying CNT, Be and graphene E and sigma. The lightest QUESTIONABLE face today is T700 at 1550 kg/m3.
fields.direction: A structural face at about 0.9-1.1 g/cc with those stiffness and strength values.
fields.effect: All three are PROJECTION. Beryllium itself cannot get lighter; that direction is a different face carrying Be-like properties.
